title: Picture to Story · Pair relay
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Picture to Story · Pair relay with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: A partner draws a simple picture of a person, place or object. The lead tells a short fictional story inspired by the picture. The story includes a recognizable element from the picture and has an ending. Form pairs. On each pair’s turn, both people make separate attempts with fresh challenges, helping only their partner. The pair earns one point only if both succeed. Each pair has two turns. Highest score wins.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 4, 6 or 8 players; materials: Paper and pencil.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Picture to Story, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The group ends the round before anyone plays.
The story includes a recognizable element from the picture and has an ending.
The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
recall.why: The story includes a recognizable element from the picture and has an ending.
